title: Verify one EUR clan-funds cheat purchase against control
changes: Complete DBG2-21 within a bounded EUR interpreter scope by pairing the separately verified Item Shop access with a visible CH-0334 resource effect and individual statuses for the remaining priority entries.
validation: Two isolated copies used the same ROM, runtime and exact quantity-one Bronze Helm checkpoint. With identical 98 input/neutral frames, the 500-gil purchase changed displayed funds from 7,749 to 7,249 without a cheat and to 99,999,499 with CH-0334 armed. Screenshots were inspected; disarming did not mutate the paused state, both checkpoints restored exactly, sessions and displays closed, and protected originals remained unchanged.

The preceding world-map observation of unchanged 7,749 funds and CH-0336 Party observation of unchanged JP 4 remain recorded as bounded negative scenarios. A naturally reached shop checkpoint was created only inside the isolated copy.
limitations: One EUR shop purchase under Wine/interpreter does not establish original device-hook behavior, other scenes, native Windows, physical controllers or the unverified priority CH entries. Disarm stops future writes; it does not undo prior memory changes.
